kurz: Yeast makes so much gas that it can blow up a balloon.
bild_im_kopf: Like a tiny bellows made of billions of yeast cells: each one breathes a little, and together it is enough for a balloon.
beobachtung: After 20–40 minutes it foams in the bottle, and the balloon stands up and inflates.
erklaerung: The [[hefe|yeast]] eats the sugar and gives off carbon dioxide. The same gas blows up the holes in bread dough. With cold water it takes much longer.
schritte: Put yeast and sugar in the bottle and add about a third of lukewarm water.
Swirl, then pull the balloon over the neck of the bottle.
Put it somewhere warm and wait.
